question: India won ______ medals in total at the 2021 AIBA Youth Men’s and Women’s World Boxing Championships in Kielce, Poland.
solution:
The correct answer is __**11.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India has won **11 medals at the 2021 AIBA Youth Men's and Women's World Boxing Championships **held in Kielce, Poland.
 
• Indian women's team scripted history and secured the highest medal haul at the prestigious event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Gitika (48kg), Naorem Babyrojisana Chanu (51kg), Poonam (57kg), Vinka(60kg), Arundhati Choudhary (69kg), T Sanamacha Chanu (75kg) and Alfiya Pathan (+81kg) clinched gold medals as India finished at the No. 1 position in the women's section with seven gold medals.
 
• The only Indian man Sachin won the men's 56kg gold medal at the event.
 
• India had sent a 20-member team to Poland for the tournament.
 
• The 10-day biennial event saw **414 boxers from 52 countries participating.**
